summary: Run Performance Evaluation Round 2 on the prior evaluation outputs and AL total_pool.csv identified as first-round iterative data; focus distributions, power, normalized cost, high-performance compositions, model iterations/accuracy, recommendations, exact chart/table paths; suffix round2.

Loaded scientific-performance-evaluator and reviewed planned-only rules, provenance separation, condition comparability, statistical/plotting protocols, expert views, benchmark rules and artifact requirements.
Read Performance Evaluation Round 1 report/YAML/queue/script and Round 2 orchestration/alignment references. Round 1 notes planned-only at that time and strict measured/predicted separation.

Inspected user-designated total_pool.csv: 160 rows, four columns id/ratio/power_density/normalized_cost, no nulls or duplicate rows, id 1-160 monotonic. Ratios parse to 8 finite nonnegative values summing to 1 to floating-point precision in legacy order [Pd,Pt,Cu,Au,Ir,Ce,Nb,Cr]. No units, conditions, iteration/source/value_type/model/prediction fields.

Compared pool schema with AL pipeline writer and README. Current writer is documented to emit iteration/source fields, while supplied file lacks them; README describes GBR virtual labels, so pool provenance cannot be assumed measured despite user designation as first experimental round.

Computed descriptive statistics only: n=160; stored power mean 54.7998, median 60.0696, sample SD 14.8008, range 0.4594-68.5811; normalized-cost proxy mean 58.9802, median 58.2193, SD 12.1778, range 0.0172-111.0067; Pearson r=0.05185 and Spearman rho=-0.15824; top-decile q90=65.47747, n=16; two-column nondominated count=10.

Generated three descriptive PNGs: power/cost distributions, power-vs-legacy-cost scatter with nondominated rows, and composition mean comparison plus mass-vector heatmap. All figures label/retain provenance and interpretation caveats in report.

Did not calculate significance tests, causal element effects, model accuracy, calibrated confidence, or iteration trajectory. These are unavailable because the CSV lacks physical value type, predictions/targets, model version, iteration, units and conditions. High-performance slice is descriptive post-selection only.

Recommended schema/provenance reconciliation, mass-basis/order verification, measured device-condition linkage, separate actual cost, controlled/replicate confirmation, paired held-out predictions for accuracy, and explicit iteration/run fields before next optimization cycle.

Created report, machine-readable evaluation YAML, review queue, Python analysis script, statistics JSON, candidate/top-decile/Pareto/composition CSVs, figures, and this trace under performance_evaluation_round2/.

Pool statistics JSON and all CSV tables parse; n=160 rows, top-decile n=16, Pareto n=10, composition summary has 8 elements, 3 expected PNGs exist; key summary statistics cross-checked; YAML LSP diagnostics show zero errors. Predictor accuracy/iteration are recorded not evaluable. No AL model/API/experiment executed.
